g.title: PB
g.text: body panel (x4, +X -X +Y -Y), H8 extended to two contacts per pole

g.title: CB
g.text: 2 cells in series, Isc ≤ 0.55 A; Pico-Clasp crimps take 26-32 AWG, so each pole is two 26 AWG wires on two contacts (0.28 A each, 0.5 A derated; EPS-13)

g.title: JB
g.text: EPS J4 PX / J5 MX / J6 PY / J7 MY

g.title: PW
g.text: wing (x2, W1 W2); harness crosses the hinge as a service loop

g.title: CW
g.text: length set with the hinge; flex-rated PTFE, tie down at both sides
